lines.en: label makicamp1:
scene nightsky
There’s a phrase I heard recently that made me stop and think for a little while.
lines.zh: 最近听到一句话，让我停下来想了好一会儿。

lines.en: It isn’t a new one, and this isn’t me saying it’s the first time I’ve heard it, but it is the first time that I’ve ever tried to seriously make sense of it, for it’s something I can’t seem to wrap my head around.
lines.zh: 那不是什么新鲜话，我也不是说第一次听到，但这是我第一次认真想弄懂它，因为我怎么也琢磨不明白。

lines.en: Love is in the air.
lines.zh: 爱在空气中弥漫。

lines.en: First and foremost, I applaud the creator of this phrase for framing love in a way that makes it sound like an airborne virus as that’s something I can actually relate to and agree with.
lines.zh: 首先，我要为造出这句话的人鼓掌——它把爱说得像一种空气传播的病毒，这倒是我真能感同身受、也认同的说法。

lines.en: But what I don’t get is why everyone looks at this like a good thing.
lines.zh: 但我不明白的是，为什么人人都把这当成好事。

lines.en: No one is ever excited to catch a cold. And public opinion when it comes to the flu is even worse.
lines.zh: 没人会因为感冒而兴奋。而说到流感，风评就更糟了。

lines.en: So why is this virus one that we all seem so determined to host? The air we breathe should remain clean at all times, should it not?
lines.zh: 那为什么偏偏这种病毒，人人都那么执意要当宿主？我们呼吸的空气不是应该始终洁净吗？

lines.en: The existence of anything swimming or flying or living in the air is a terrifying concept, and it calls into question why more people don’t wear masks outside of the more popular pandemics.
lines.zh: 空气里有任何东西在游动、在飞翔、在存活，都是个可怕的概念，这也让人不禁要问：为什么在那些更出名的疫情之外，没有更多人戴上口罩。

lines.en: Maybe I should start doing that.
lines.zh: 也许我该开始这么做。

lines.en: Maybe covering my face would prevent me from falling for anyone who accidentally contaminates the air in the midst of some lukewarm debate on wires or the concept of breathing.
lines.zh: 也许把脸遮住，就能让我不至于爱上那些在关于电线或呼吸概念的温吞争论中，不小心污染了空气的人。

lines.en: Because even if I don’t believe it’s love, my broken mind can’t help but display the symptoms of it.
lines.zh: 因为就算我不相信那是爱，我这颗坏掉的脑子还是会不由自主地表现出它的症状。

lines.en: It’s the same for everyone else who breathes on me and winds up getting tricked by the failure of their immune system into some state that makes their legs shake.
lines.zh: 所有朝我呼气的人也一样，最后都被自己免疫系统的失灵骗进了某种双腿发软的状态。

lines.en: We’re all just sick.
lines.zh: 我们都只是病了。

lines.en: So when I hear someone say that “love is in the air,” I can’t help but feel a little worried.
lines.zh: 所以每当我听到有人说「爱在空气中弥漫」，我总忍不住有点担心。

lines.en: I can’t help but be a little scared — because there’s no way I can live without breathing, and I’m too cowardly to die at such a slow pace.
lines.zh: 我总忍不住有点害怕——因为不呼吸我就活不下去，而我又是那么懦弱，连以这么缓慢的速度死去都不敢。

lines.en: I can hold my breath as much as I want.
lines.zh: 我想憋多久气就憋多久。

lines.en: I can hide inside my home and hope the cracks beneath my doors suffice at keeping fresh air out.
lines.zh: 我可以躲在家里，盼着门缝底下那些缝隙足以把新鲜空气挡在外面。

lines.en: But the rotting carcasses of those I’ve left behind are simply far too pungent now, and even masks and doors won’t keep their stench away from this cursed respiratory system.
lines.zh: 可那些被我抛在身后的人留下的腐尸，如今气味实在太冲，就算是口罩和门板，也挡不住那股恶臭飘进我这该死的呼吸系统。

lines.en: scene black
I try to calm my nerves.
lines.zh: 我试着让自己镇定下来。

lines.en: It never works.
lines.zh: 从来没用。

lines.en: There is only one thing that will.
lines.zh: 只有一样东西管用。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp1
: Okay, give me the hardest shit you’ve got.
lines.zh: : 好，把你这儿最猛的货都给我。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp2
: Go to the back room and take your pants off. I’ll be there with the lube in five. And I promise it’ll only hurt for the first ten minutes.
lines.zh: : 去后间把裤子脱了。五分钟后我带着润滑过去。我保证只有头十分钟会疼。

lines.en: : Tough day?
lines.zh: : 今天不好过？

lines.en: : Every day is tough when you’ve lost the will to live.
lines.zh: : 失去求生欲的时候，哪一天都不好过。

lines.en: : That’s where the pegging comes in. Why are you still here when you should be preparing your anus?
lines.zh: : 所以才要靠爆菊来解决。你不是该去准备一下你的后庭吗，怎么还在这儿？

lines.en: : That’s not- forget it. I’ll just fill a basket with anything I can find and hope that something works.
lines.zh: : 那不是——算了。我就往篮子里塞满能抓到的一切，指望其中有个管用的。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp3
: Is your libido broken this time? Because Haruka is a self-proclaimed master when it comes to helping others re-find the horny. And maybe it’s your turn to be fixed instead of mine?
lines.zh: : 这次是你的性欲出问题了？因为 Haruka 自称是帮别人重新找回发情状态的大师。说不定这回轮到被治好的人是你，而不是我了？

lines.en: : I’m not looking to fix anybody right now. I’m just glad to see you’re still alive and well.
lines.zh: : 我现在没想治好谁。我只是很高兴看到你还活得好好的。

lines.en: : I am not well at all, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不好，Haruka。

lines.en: : Well hey, alive and unwell beats dead, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嘿，活着但不舒服，总比死了强，不是吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’d say you could ask Maki’s husband, but I’m not sure you’d get a response.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我倒想说你可以去问 Maki 的丈夫，不过我不确定你会得到回应。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp4
: Nice.
lines.zh: : 漂亮。

lines.en: : Ignoring the fact that I’m apparently the only one here without a morbid sense of humor, are you sure porn is the remedy to your missing will to live?
lines.zh: : 先不提我明显是这儿唯一一个没有黑色幽默感的人——你确定色情片能治好你缺失的求生欲？

lines.en: : There can be no remedy at this point, only distractions. So I will drown my sorrows in my own cum while my niece eats microwaved TV dinners and cries her eyes out a few walls over.
lines.zh: : 到了这一步已经没有解药了，只有分心的东西。所以我要把自己的悲伤淹死在自己的精液里，与此同时我侄女在几堵墙之外吃着微波炉加热的电视晚餐、哭得撕心裂肺。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp5
: That one was too real for me to laugh at. Sorry, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这句话太真实了，我笑不出来。抱歉，老师。

lines.en: : Go home and get some sleep, man. Because, as much as I want Maki’s shop to succeed, I feel like someone has to put their foot down right now and she’s way too much of a salesman to ever do that.
lines.zh: : 回家睡一觉吧，老兄。因为虽然我很想让 Maki 的店生意兴隆，但我觉得现在总得有人站出来踩个刹车，而她推销员性子太重，永远干不出这种事。

lines.en: : I can only sleep so many hours, you know. What am I supposed to do with the rest of the day?
lines.zh: : 可我一天能睡的也就那么多小时，你知道的。剩下的时间我该干嘛？

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp6
: I mean...you could just hang out with us as we’re both adults who have also endured hardship and wouldn’t judge you at any point for what you’re going through.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你可以就跟着我们混呗，我们俩也都是经历过苦难的成年人，不管你在经历什么，都不会在任何时候评判你。

lines.en: : She’s got a point, Sensei. And it’s kind of surprising that you haven’t really tried leaning on either of us at all during this extremely prolonged and sudden bout of sadness that no one understands but you.
lines.zh: : 她说得有道理，老师。而且真挺让人意外的，在这场拖得极长、又来得突然、除了你自己没人能理解的悲伤里，你居然一次都没想过依靠我们中的任何一个。

lines.en: : And hey, now that I’m a widow, you can even marry me if you want to take advantage of my health benefits and go seek out actual therapy instead or something.
lines.zh: : 而且嘿，现在我是寡妇了，你要是想蹭我的医疗保险、或者干脆去看真正的心理医生什么的，甚至可以跟我结婚。

lines.en: : At the very least, that’d be the funniest way to cancel out the un-submitted marriage license your daughter has been holding over my head for months.
lines.zh: : 至少，这是抵掉你女儿拿在手里威胁了我好几个月、还没交上去的结婚证的最好笑的方式。

lines.en: : The what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Did...Makoto trick you into signing a marriage license? Because she did something like that with me when she was little as well and I wouldn’t put it past her.
lines.zh: : Makoto 是不是骗你签了结婚证？她小时候也这么对付过我，我觉得她干得出来。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp7
: Your...daughter made you fill out a marriage license?
lines.zh: : 你……女儿让你填了一份结婚证？

lines.en: : No, it was a recommendation letter for Harvard. She just asked to see my signature and then printed a whole ass form on top of it.
lines.zh: : 不是，是哈佛的推荐信。她只是说想看看我的签名，然后在上面印了一整张该死的表格。

lines.en: : Joke's on her, though. Harvard doesn’t give a shit what some mid-thirties porn dealer has to say. I don’t even know where Harvard is.
lines.zh: : 不过笑到最后的还是我。哈佛才不在乎一个三十多岁的色情贩子说什么。我连哈佛在哪儿都不知道。

lines.en: : Nowhere you have to worry about her actually going to so long as we’re all trapped in here. But, that’s enough about Makoto. Give me everything you’ve got.
lines.zh: : 只要我们都被困在这儿，你就不用担心她真会去。不过，Makoto 的话题到此为止。把你所有的货都给我。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp8
: Are you robbing me now? Do I need to go get my rifle?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在打劫我吗？我要不要去拿我的来福枪？

lines.en: : You mean the horse dildo?
lines.zh: : 你是说那根马用假阳具？

lines.en: : Rifle. Horse cock. Same difference.
lines.zh: : 来福枪。马鸡巴。差不多一个意思。

lines.en: : I’m not robbing you. I’m just starting to feel normal by standing here and talking to you two and would like to crawl back into my hole and stop existing now.
lines.zh: : 我不是打劫你。我只是站在这儿跟你们俩说话，才开始感觉正常了点，现在想爬回我的洞里、停止存在了。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp9
: Heh. Hole.
lines.zh: : 呵。洞。

lines.en: : Is that why you never came to either of us? You want to feel miserable?
lines.zh: : 所以你从来没来找我们俩，就是这个原因？你想沉浸在痛苦里？

lines.en: : Don’t you do the same thing when you’re upset?
lines.zh: : 你不也是这样吗，难过的时候？

lines.en: : No, Haruka just calls upon everyone else for validation and attention until whatever’s causing her sadness goes away.
lines.zh: : 不，Haruka 是只会把所有人都叫来给她认同和关注，直到让她难过的东西消失为止。

lines.en: : Yeah. I never want to be sad. I just want people to feel bad for me. So, if that’s what you’re doing now-
lines.zh: : 对。我从不想难过。我只是想让别人同情我。所以，如果你现在是在做这种事的话-

lines.en: : That’s not what I’m doing. I just don’t really know how to exist right now and it feels like everything I try to do makes things worse. So stasis seems like the only option.
lines.zh: : 我做的不是那种事。我只是现在真的不知道该怎么活下去，而且感觉我做的每一件事都让情况变得更糟。所以停滞似乎是唯一的选择。

lines.en: : What about Ami, though?
lines.zh: : 那 Ami 呢？

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp10
: Yeah, what’s going on with her? Makoto said something about...organ harvesting recently?
lines.zh: : 对啊，她怎么了？Makoto 前阵子说了些……器官贩卖之类的？

lines.en: if harukasex == True:
: That sounds about right.
lines.zh: : 听起来差不多。

lines.en: : Ami...isn’t doing so great.
lines.zh: : Ami……状态不太好。

lines.en: : “Not great” as in refusing to eat and keeping herself locked in her room for days on end like Makoto did when Masahiro died? Or “not great” as in Haruka complaining about being lonely?
lines.zh: : 「不太好」是指像 Masahiro 死时 Makoto 那样，拒绝进食、把自己锁在房间里一连好几天？还是指像 Haruka 那样抱怨寂寞的那种「不太好」？

lines.en: : Neither, really. She’s awake and conscious and replies to me when I speak to her, but she’s not leaving the house and seems just...completely dead inside.
lines.zh: : 其实都不是。她醒着、有意识，我说话她也会回应，可她不出门，而且看起来……整个人从里面死掉了。

lines.en: : She’s been under a lot of mental stress lately and I’m pretty sure she’s blaming herself for the way I am. Which, on its own, would be one thing-
lines.zh: : 她最近精神压力很大，而且我基本可以确定她在把我的状态归咎于自己。单看这一点也就罢了-

lines.en: : But when combined with the fact that she’s already all sorts of fucked up from being raised by me, it makes things kind of snowball into some big clusterfuck that I don’t know what to do about.
lines.zh: : 可再叠加一个事实——她被我养大，本来就各方面都被搞得一团糟——事情就滚雪球似地滚成了一大团我不知道该怎么收拾的烂摊子。

lines.en: : That just sounds like parenting, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这听起来就是为人父母嘛。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s the problem. I don’t know how to be a parent.
lines.zh: : 是啊，问题就在这儿。我不知道该怎么做父母。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp11
: You and me both, buddy.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此，老兄。

lines.en: : Have you tried asking Sara? She’s all about parenting stuff. Even if she occasionally medicates her teenage daughter with exorbitant amounts of alcohol.
lines.zh: : 你问过 Sara 吗？她最擅长的就是育儿那套。哪怕她偶尔会用大量酒精给她十几岁的女儿当药。

lines.en: : I haven’t. The only person I’ve really asked for help isn’t a parent either.
lines.zh: : 没有。我真正开口求助过的那个人，也不是当父母的。

lines.en: : Well, it’s no wonder why you’re still struggling then. Just talk to Sara. I’m sure she’ll have some idea of what to do to get Ami back to normal. And if she doesn’t-
lines.zh: : 那难怪你一直挣扎到现在了。去跟 Sara 聊聊吧。我敢肯定她会有办法让 Ami 恢复常态。就算她没有-

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp12
: Go camping with us tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 明天跟我们去露营吧。

lines.en: : That is...a strange alternative to what Haruka just said.
lines.zh: : 那……跟 Haruka 刚说的可是个奇怪的替代方案。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp13
: Come to think of it, that’s actually a great idea.
lines.zh: : 这么一想，这其实是个好主意。

lines.en: : Right? It’ll be just like the “Make Maki Horny Again” trip, but fractionally more depressing.
lines.zh: : 对吧？就跟那次「让 Maki 重新发情」之旅一样，只是稍微更压抑一点。

lines.en: : And...how is camping going to make me a better parent, exactly? It’s not going to turn into some type of boot camp, is it?
lines.zh: : 可是……露营到底怎么能让我变成更好的家长？它总不会变成什么新兵训练营吧？

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp14
: Not at all. A few of us girls were just looking to unwind and, since the weather’s been great lately, we figured we’d head out into the woods and try not to be eaten by bears.
lines.zh: : 完全不会。我们几个姑娘只是想放松一下，而且最近天气不错，就想着去林子里，尽量别被熊吃掉。

lines.en: : So what Maki’s suggesting is that you and Ami come along and try not to be eaten by bears too.
lines.zh: : 所以 Maki 的意思是，你和 Ami 也一起来，一起尽量别被熊吃掉。

lines.en: : Yeah! We can all avoid being eaten by bears together! Plus, Sara will be there and she might be able to help with the Ami situation.
lines.zh: : 对啊！我们可以一起避免被熊吃掉！而且 Sara 也会去，她说不定能帮上 Ami 那边的忙。

lines.en: : Sure. Except for the part where “the Ami situation” involves her not wanting to leave her room. There’s no way I can talk her into going camping. She’ll look at me like I’m insane.
lines.zh: : 行啊。除了「Ami 那边的问题」里还包括她根本不想出房间这一点。我绝不可能说服她去露营。她会像看疯子一样看着我。

lines.en: : How can you be so sure? For all you know, Ami might have been waiting for you to do something like this for years.
lines.zh: : 你怎么能这么肯定？说不定 Ami 已经等了你这么多年，就盼着你做点这样的事。

lines.en: : No harm in trying, right?
lines.zh: : 试试也没坏处，对吧？

lines.en: : Unless you don’t want to come, that is.
lines.zh: : 除非你自己不想来。

lines.en: : Or you’re just afraid of bears.
lines.zh: : 或者你只是怕熊。

lines.en: Camping?...
lines.zh: 露营？……

lines.en: I can’t say that’s...something I have much interest in, to tell you the truth. And I can’t imagine Ami would either given that she’s a girly-girl in practically every sense.
lines.zh: 说实话，我不能说我对那玩意儿有多大兴趣。我也想象不出 Ami 会感兴趣，毕竟她几乎在每一种意义上都是个娇滴滴的小姑娘。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 可是……

lines.en: Maybe this would be an opportunity to turn things around? For her.
lines.zh: 也许这是个扭转局面的机会？对她来说。

lines.en: My happiness comes second- and I’m not just saying that because I’ve all but abandoned it.
lines.zh: 我的幸福排在第二位——而我这么说，不只是因为我已经几乎把它放弃了。

lines.en: If Ami can find some semblance of normalcy in her life again...even if that normalcy comes in the form of something that wouldn’t be normal at all for us...
lines.zh: 如果 Ami 能在生活里重新找到一点常态的影子……哪怕那种常态的形式对我们来说完全算不上正常……

lines.en: Maybe it would make pretending to be okay a little easier on my end?
lines.zh: 也许这能让我假装没事的时候轻松一点？

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: And maybe it would make her less afraid to open the door.
lines.zh: : 而且也许能让她不那么害怕打开房门。

lines.en: : I’ll...talk to her tonight.
lines.zh: : 我……今晚跟她谈谈。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp15
: My parental genius knows no bounds! So long as it involves other people’s children and not my own.
lines.zh: : 我的育儿天赋简直无边无际！只要涉及的是别人家的孩子，而不是我自己的。

lines.en: : You think she’ll be okay with a bunch of women your age also being there?
lines.zh: : 你觉得她会介意有一群你这个年纪的女人也在场吗？

lines.en: : Not even slightly.
lines.zh: : 一点都不介意才怪。

lines.en: : Yeah, I didn’t think so.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也觉得不会。

lines.en: : Like you said, though, there’s no harm in trying. And it’s a somewhat passive way for me to start ascending the steps to parenthood.
lines.zh: : 不过就像你说的，试试也没坏处。而且这算是一种比较被动的方式，让我开始踏上为人父母的台阶。

lines.en: scene black
: That settles it, then! Sensei and Ami will come camping with us tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了！老师和 Ami 明天跟我们去露营！

lines.en: : She hasn’t agreed yet, Maki...
lines.zh: : 她还没答应呢，Maki……

lines.en: : But she will!
lines.zh: : 但她会答应的！

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: : Good enough for me! We’ll pick you up at 9:00.
lines.zh: : 对我来说够用了！我们九点来接你。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是-

lines.en: : Just talk to her when you get home and give Maki a call when you find out.
lines.zh: : 回家跟她谈谈，等有结果了给 Maki 打个电话就行。

lines.en: : Worse comes to worst and she still drops by in the morning despite Ami not wanting to go, I can just restrain her and prevent her from honking.
lines.zh: : 最坏的情况，就算 Ami 不想去，她明早还是跑来了，我只要把她按住、别让她按喇叭就行。

lines.en: : But I love honking the horn and I never get to do it! Don’t take this from me, Haruka!
lines.zh: : 可我最喜欢按喇叭了，而且从来没机会按！别把这个从我手里抢走，Haruka！

lines.en: I take it upon myself to sneak away as the two of them argue.
lines.zh: 趁她们俩吵起来，我自作主张地溜走了。

lines.en: But, just when I think I’m safe, I wind up bumping into something else...
lines.zh: 可就在我以为自己安全了的时候，我撞上了别的东西……

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp16
: Hey...
: How...are things?
lines.zh: : 最近……怎么样？

lines.en: : Oh, you know...
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的……

lines.en: : Terrible.
lines.zh: : 糟透了。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp17
: I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : Do you think they’ll maybe...stop being terrible soon?
lines.zh: : 你觉得它们也许……很快就不那么糟了吗？

lines.en: : Probably not, to be honest...
lines.zh: : 说实话，大概不会……

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp18
: Sensei, I-
lines.zh: : 老师，我-

lines.en: : Are you going camping tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 你明天要去露营吗？

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp19
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Camping...with your mom. Are you going?
lines.zh: : 露营……跟你妈一起。你要去吗？

lines.en: : Are...are you going?
lines.zh: : 你……你要去吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know yet. Probably not.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道。大概不去。

lines.en: : I’m trying to be a parent.
lines.zh: : 我在努力当个家长。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp20
: A parent?
lines.zh: : 家长？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: That’s...different.
lines.zh: : 那……很不一样啊。

lines.en: : Yeah. Everything’s different now. And none of it’s really good.
lines.zh: : 嗯。现在什么都不一样了。而且没有一样是好的。

lines.en: : I figured as much on account of you not even showing up to the dorms anymore. And to think that all it took was something worse than the apocalypse in your eyes.
lines.zh: : 看你连宿舍都不来了，我就猜到了。想想也是，能让你变成这样，得是件在你眼里比世界末日还糟的事。

lines.en: : I guess this means you’re a true member of the club now, huh?
lines.zh: : 这么说，你现在算是这个俱乐部的正式成员了，是吧？

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp21
: Yeah, I guess so. I’m not really sure what to do, though. Nothing I say about it sticks with anyone other than Ayane.
lines.zh: : 嗯，大概是吧。不过我真不知道该怎么办。我说的话除了 Ayane 之外，没有谁能听进去。

lines.en: : Help her out, okay?
lines.zh: : 帮帮她，好吗？

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp20
: Help her?
lines.zh: : 帮她？

lines.en: : Yeah. With how fucked I am right now, you’re kind of the only person she has to talk to about any of this since I just...don’t want to be bothered for the time being.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我现在烂成这样，加上我暂时……不想被打扰，你基本就是她唯一能倾诉这些的人了。

lines.en: : And you think I do?
lines.zh: : 你以为我就想被打扰吗？

lines.en: : No. But I know you’re enough of a teacher’s pet to do what I tell you.
lines.zh: : 不。但我知道你够听话，我让你做什么你就会做什么。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp22
: You’re not even my teacher anymore.
lines.zh: : 你都已经不是我的老师了。

lines.en: : I’ll always be your teacher and you know that.
lines.zh: : 我永远都是你的老师，这一点你心里清楚。

lines.en: : Makoto, I’m really sorry. I’ve got a lot of shit I have to figure out right now.
lines.zh: : Makoto，我真的很抱歉。我眼下有一大堆烂摊子要处理。

lines.en: : You’ve had a lot of shit to figure out since the first time you walked into the classroom. The difference is that now you finally have to figure it out or we’ll all leave you behind.
lines.zh: : 从你第一天踏进教室起，你就有一大堆烂摊子要处理。区别在于，现在你终于必须把它处理掉，否则我们都会把你抛下。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s for the best.
lines.zh: : 也许那样最好。

lines.en: : It’s not.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp23
: At least not for me. But new Makoto doesn’t have time to care about what anyone else wants as she’s too busy playing the game for the first time in her life.
lines.zh: : 至少对我来说不是。不过全新的 Makoto 没空在乎别人想要什么，她正忙着有生以来第一次玩这场游戏呢。

lines.en: : Still have that marriage license?
lines.zh: : 那份结婚证还在吗？

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp24
: Mhm. And no, you can’t have it.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不行，你不能拿走。

lines.en: : That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没关系。

lines.en: : Is it?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, hang on to it. It might come in handy one day.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你留着吧。说不定哪天派得上用场。

lines.en: scene makiwantstocamp25
: It might-
lines.zh: : 说不定-

lines.en: : If I need health benefits or something.
lines.zh: : 如果我哪天需要医疗保险什么的。

lines.en: : Health...benefits?
lines.zh: : 医疗……保险？

lines.en: scene black
: Are you coming camping tomorrow or not?
lines.zh: : 你明天到底来不来露营？

lines.en: : Camping...right! I...
lines.zh: : 露营……对！我……

lines.en: : I can’t...
lines.zh: : 我去不了……

lines.en: : But maybe some other time-
lines.zh: : 不过也许改天-

lines.en: : Yeah. Maybe some other time.
lines.zh: : 嗯。也许改天吧。

lines.en: : Are you leaving? Already?...
lines.zh: : 你要走了吗？这么快？……

lines.en: : I’ll call you.
lines.zh: : 我会给你打电话的。

lines.en: : Will you actually?...
lines.zh: : 真的会吗？……

lines.en: : We’ll see.
lines.zh: : 再看吧。

lines.en: : Only one way to find out.
lines.zh: : 只有一种办法能知道。

lines.en: $ makicamp1 = True
$ maki_love += 1
$ haruka_love += 1
$ makoto_love += 1
jump amicamp1
